class.name: FSR3Upscaler
class.brief_description: Built-in source FidelityFX Super Resolution 3.1.4 temporal upscaler.
class.description: Uses GPU shaders compiled into the engine. Select [constant Viewport.SCALING_3D_MODE_FSR3] to let a viewport own and configure this resource automatically. Forward+ is required. A scale of 1.0 provides Native AA. No GDExtension or AMD runtime library is required. Frame generation is not implemented.

method.name: configure_scale
method.description: Configures temporal jitter phases for the render scale and resets history. Managed viewports call this automatically.

method.name: get_context_count
method.description: Returns the cumulative number of source contexts created, including recreation after resizing.

method.name: get_dispatch_count
method.description: Returns the number of successful upscaling dispatches.

method.name: get_failure_count
method.description: Returns the number of failed source or external GPU dispatches.

method.name: get_gpu_dispatch_count
method.description: Returns the number of source compute passes submitted to the GPU.

method.name: reset_history
method.description: Resets temporal history on the next rendered frame. Call after a camera cut or teleport.

members.member: Source FSR3 sharpening strength from 0.0 to 1.0.
